stack: Native Android (Kotlin + Jetpack Compose), MVVM + Hilt DI, Supabase (Postgres + Auth + Realtime + Storage)
stage: Pre-release / internal distribution (signed APK sideload, no Play Store)

architecture.rationale: Verified via src/ layout: clean MVVM + Hilt + type-safe Compose navigation. Data, screens, navigation, and updater layers are separated. Registration and approval flows are now real data paths instead of demo paths. Minor: cross-screen flow state still lives partly in AppNavigation composable rather than a dedicated ViewModel.

code_quality.rationale: Verified via read_file + grep: consistent Compose style, detekt/ktlint configured, ProGuard minify enabled. Mock data removed from parent dashboard and registration flow; backend models remain only where needed. Errors are surfaced rather than swallowed in the repository layer. Minor: some legacy 'Mock*' naming remains for real domain models.

security.rationale: Verified: RLS enabled on all tables in migrations; anon key only in client; service_role never shipped. Storage bucket policies present. Risk remains: self-updater has no SHA-256/signature integrity check before install; PoP upload now uses real filenames but still no client-side scan/content validation; audit logs are local-only and not protected if the device is rooted.

testing.rationale: Verified: unit tests compile and exist, but coverage is thin. No auth/authorization/role-gate tests; no regression test for registration->approval->student creation; no self-updater install-path tests. Existing tests assert low-level network behavior, not the critical user-facing flows.

documentation.rationale: Verified: README covers prerequisites, layout, Supabase config, migrations, build, signing, architecture notes, and known limitations. Gaps: no CI docs, README still slightly stale vs current build config, and no runbook for common failure modes like DB auto-pause recovery or how to inspect audit logs on device.

deployment.rationale: Verified: signed release builds succeed and are distributed via GitHub Releases; keystore backed up off-machine; migrations tracked in repo. Risks: no CI/CD pipeline to gate releases; Supabase free-tier auto-pause can cause full outage without manual resume; no automated backup of production data.

performance.rationale: Verified via inspected data paths: REST over OkHttp + direct WebSocket, no obvious N+1 or unbounded queries in inspected flows, and scroll/list UI fixed with lazy containers. No runtime profiling was performed, so loading/latency metrics are still unmeasured.

maintainability.rationale: Verified: single config layer via BuildConfig from gitignored supabase.properties, detekt/ktlint present, consistent package structure, Hilt DI. Easy onboarding from README. Minor: incremental fixes have increased file-local branches in SupabaseRepository.kt and AppNavigation.kt, creating some long functions.

important.title: Self-updater installs APK without integrity verification
important.problem: AppUpdater.downloadApk() fetches the GitHub release asset and launches installIntent() with only a semver comparison. No SHA-256/hash or signing-certificate verification before install.
important.impact: A compromised release asset could install malicious code with the app's permissions. HTTPS transport alone does not protect against tampered binaries or release metadata.
important.evidence: Verified — AppUpdater.kt download/install path does not verify file integrity before ACTION_INSTALL_PACKAGE.
important.action: Add pinned SHA-256 verification or signing-certificate check before install. Reject mismatched binaries.

important.title: No automated coverage for auth, role gating, and core registration/approval/student creation flow
important.problem: Unit tests exist, but do not exercise login, RLS-enforced row access, parent/admin role gates, or the registration->application->proof-of-payment->approval->student creation loop.
important.impact: Regressions in core flows can ship undetected. This is the highest-risk untested path in the current build.
important.evidence: Verified — tests focus on low-level behavior; README notes no E2E/device test of the core flow; no assertions around role access or approval path.
important.action: Add auth login/logout test, role-gate read-access test, and at least one happy-path registration-submit + approval test.

important.title: Supabase free tier can auto-pause and take the app offline
important.problem: Free-tier Supabase pauses after ~1 week idle. Every network call then fails until the project is resumed manually from the dashboard.
important.impact: Users see login, registration, and payment failures with no app-side recovery path. This has already occurred and will recur.
important.evidence: Verified earlier in session via observed 521/fetch-failed until dashboard resume. No keep-alive automation present.
important.action: Add a scheduled daily keep-alive ping and document manual recovery steps in README.
